## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the save command before merge because it reports success when the destination cannot be written.

## Changes

The pull request adds a report-saving function that announces its destination and a cleanup function that tolerates an already absent temporary report. It also adds tests for both functions.

## Critical

- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Report write failures to the caller — When the destination’s parent directory is missing, `save_report` discards the resulting `FileNotFoundError`, prints `Report saved to ...`, and returns `0`. — A caller can proceed as though the report exists even though no file was created. — Fix: Report the destination and write error, return a nonzero status, and extend `test_save_with_unavailable_destination`.
